# Repository Guide for Agents

## Purpose

This repository is Md. Tariquzzaman's Jekyll academic website, based on Academic Pages / Minimal Mistakes.

## Build and verification

Run commands from the repository root.

```bash
bundle exec jekyll build
```

The generated site is written to `_site/`. A successful build is required after changing content, configuration, Liquid, layouts, includes, Sass, JavaScript, or assets.

For local preview:

```bash
bundle exec jekyll serve
```

Restart the server after changing `_config.yml`.

## Do not edit generated or dependency files

- `_site/` is generated by Jekyll.
- `vendor/`, `.bundle/`, and `node_modules/` contain dependencies or local tooling state.
- `Gemfile.lock` should change only during an intentional dependency update.
- Edit source Sass and JavaScript rather than generated or vendored files.

| Desired change | Edit here |
| --- | --- |
| Site metadata, author details, email, and social links | `_config.yml` |

| Homepage biography, placeholder news, highlight layout, and research map | `_pages/about.md` |

| CV landing page | `_pages/cv.md` |
| CV PDF | `files/tariq.pdf` |
| Profile and content images | `images/` |
| Shared styling | `assets/css/main.scss` and `_sass/` |

| Main content width and desktop grid | `_sass/_page.scss` |
| Masthead container and fixed header | `_sass/_masthead.scss` |

Paths and filenames are case-sensitive on GitHub Pages.

## Current public pages

- `/` is generated from `_pages/about.md`.
- `/research/` uses `_pages/publications.html` and `_data/research.yml`.
- `/experience/` uses `_pages/teaching.html` and is labeled Experience.
- `/cv/` uses `_pages/cv.md`; navigation links directly to `files/tariq.pdf`.
- `/sitemap/` lists the current public pages.
- `/404.html` is the not-found page.

## Layout and responsive behavior

`assets/css/main.scss` is the Sass entry point. It imports the partials in `_sass/`; edit the partials rather than generated CSS.

The primary breakpoints in `_sass/_variables.scss` are:

- `$small`: 600px
- `$medium`: 768px
- `$medium-wide`: 900px
- `$large`: 925px
- `$x-large`: 1280px

The masthead and page content must share the same horizontal frame:

- `.masthead__inner-wrap` in `_sass/_masthead.scss` and `#main` in `_sass/_page.scss` both use the Susy container, `1em` horizontal padding, and a 1280px maximum at `$x-large`.
- `_layouts/single.html` detects whether a page has an author/sidebar. Pages without one receive `page--wide`; pages with one retain the desktop author column.
- At `$large`, sidebar pages use a 10-of-12 right-aligned page span with a 0.5-column left prefix. There is intentionally no right suffix, so content ends at the same right edge as the navigation.
- At `$large`, `.page--wide` resets the grid and uses the full content container. `/research/` depends on this because `author_profile: false`.

Do not restore the old `suffix(2 of 12)` reservation or add page-specific fixed/max-width workarounds to align the right edge. The homepage News box is intentionally uncapped and follows its parent content width.

## Navigation behavior

- `_data/navigation.yml` defines Research, Experience, and the direct CV PDF link.
- `_includes/masthead.html` marks an internal link current when `page.url == link.url`, adding `class="is-current"` and `aria-current="page"`.
- `_sass/_navigation.scss` uses the same pseudo-element underline for hover and `.is-current`, making the underline persistent on Research and Experience.
- The CV item targets `files/tariq.pdf` in a new tab. Because it is a file rather than a rendered website page, it does not receive a current-page state.
- The site title links to `/` but is not currently styled as an active navigation item on the homepage.

## Page-local implementations

- `_pages/about.md` contains the homepage-specific button, News box, Research Map CSS/JavaScript, and highlight rendering. The introduction links to the IUT lecturer profile and IUT website; both links are intentionally black and permanently underlined through `.justified-text` styles.
- `_pages/publications.html` is a full-width page with a two-column desktop layout. Its 190px sticky topic navigation is hidden at 1023px and below; paper data comes from `_data/research.yml`.
- `_pages/teaching.html` has the author sidebar and page-local flex/card styling for education and experience rows.
- Some content pages currently contain inline `<style>` blocks and legacy document-level `<html>`/`<head>` tags inside Jekyll layout output. Prefer shared Sass for reusable styles and do not add more nested document-level tags. Treat cleanup as a separate change and inspect generated HTML afterward.

## Research data

`_data/research.yml` is the shared source for the Research page and homepage highlights. Keep topic and paper IDs unique.

`_data/research_highlights.yml` contains an ordered `paper_ids` list. Every selected ID must match a paper in `_data/research.yml`.

Add meaningful alt text and use case-correct paths for every image.

## Homepage research map

The interactive map is implemented inline in `_pages/about.md` with D3 loaded from `https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js`.

- `topicColors` and `topicLabels` define the seven keyword categories.
- Nodes are generated from every paper in `_data/research.yml`.
- Each paper's required `nodename` field supplies its short graph label and is not rendered on the Research page.
- Links are generated when two papers share at least one keyword.
- Paper IDs must be unique, and every paper must have two or three keywords matching `Topic 1` through `Topic 7`.

## Safe change workflow

1. Identify the canonical source file using the source map above.
2. Search all references before renaming an asset, route, or identifier.
3. Preserve valid YAML front matter and Liquid syntax.
4. Do not edit `_site/` directly.
5. Run `bundle exec jekyll build`.
6. Inspect generated output for changed routes, links, embeds, and navigation.
7. Confirm all referenced local assets exist with exactly matching case.
8. Verify generated identity and contact details match the intended values in `_config.yml` and page content.

For responsive layout changes, verify both sidebar pages (`/`, `/experience/`) and the full-width Research page (`/research/`) around 925px, 1024px, and 1280px. For navigation changes, confirm generated links carry `is-current` and `aria-current="page"` only on their matching route.
